60-74.opener: Decent effort, but a few things to address.

40-59.opener: Your pressing form needs significant attention.

grip_ratio.note: grip_ratio=(grip_width - shoulder_width)/shoulder_width; ideal 5-25% wider than shoulders

bar_path_deviation.note: horizontal XZ drift from bottom to top / shoulder_width; body-local frame

min_elbow_angle.note: 3D elbow angle at maximum flexion; <= 75 = full ROM, > 90 = no credit

max_elbow_angle.note: 3D elbow angle at lockout, sustained >= 0.5 s

elbow_flare.note: mean shoulder abduction during concentric phase; 0 = arm along torso, 90 = horizontal out

shoulder_elevation.needs_work: Work on pressing the bar fully overhead.
shoulder_elevation.focus_here: Your lockout is incomplete — the bar needs to finish directly over your shoulders.

elbow_extension.needs_work: Focus on fully extending your elbows at the top.
elbow_extension.focus_here: Elbow extension is insufficient — lock out completely at the top of each rep.

combined_cue.needs_work: Work on your lockout: press higher and extend the elbows fully.
combined_cue.focus_here: Your lockout needs significant work — incomplete extension and insufficient height.

bar_path_deviation.needs_work: Work on keeping the bar path vertical.
bar_path_deviation.focus_here: The bar path is drifting significantly — focus on pressing straight up.

forward_lean.needs_work: Stay more upright during the press.
forward_lean.focus_here: Excessive forward lean — brace your core and stay vertical.

combined_cue.needs_work: Work on your bar path: stay upright and press vertically.
combined_cue.focus_here: Bar path and body lean both need attention — brace hard and press straight.
